dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Buloburto City and surroundings, Buloburto District, Hiraan Region, Somalia, 30 November 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20231105SOM** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Buloburto City, Buloburto District, Hiraan Region, Somalia as observed from a Worldview-2 image acquired on 30 November 2023. Within the analysed area of about 150 km2 about 23 km2 of land appears to be flooded. Furthermore, within the analysed area 7,151 buildings are identified as potentially affected by the floods as of 30 November 2023. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
